title: Artificial Intelligence-Powered Optimization and Milk Permeate Upcycling for Innovative Sesame Milk with Enhanced Probiotic Viability and Sensory Appeal.
summary: ANN-guided sesame-milk extraction was checked against an actual total-solids yield, and the study measured that permeate-containing milk supported lactic-acid-bacteria growth and had sensory/nutritional properties.
ai_technology: Artificial neural networks optimized sesame-milk extraction conditions against total-solids yield, followed by experimental confirmation.

evidence.unknown: The reported optimization and product assays are confined to the tested sesame-milk formulation and conditions; health effects in consumers were not studied.
